Need upstream PDI updates for propreties and paths. Need to align with https://github.com/openbmc/docs/blob/master/designs/bmc-health-monitor.md in terms of D-Bus path and property naming.
Acknowledged
Reopening as I don't think this is done yet?
Done. PDI - https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/+/84839
why do we need such checks?
Replace it with only one check for the size.
Do we really need 3 classes? The VDM command is same with few param changes. Can we rewrite as one class?

We can rewrite it as one class, but it will going to have all DBus Interfaces that are divided in three separated classes and we would have to decide on how to update those interface based on request param. And hence it wouldn't bring down LOC in this file by much.
Can you use https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/84508 here?
Done
This will have to change to something else as this patch is abandoned.
Yes, I will update the patch once we have replacement for that patch from @molberding@nvidia.com.
Why do you need this patch? The port info is coming from the device.
Done
Is it an error to get partial telemetry back from the device?
Removed this check.
can we avoid this magic number?
Done
Aren't we utlilizing the entire response?
No, not all metrics in the response are exposed to redfish.
can we avoid this magic number?
Done
can we avoid this magic number?
Done
The code duplication in cpp and hpp here is concerning. The same MCTP VDM command used with minor variations. Why can't this be one class type instead of 3?
Aren't you supposed to make D-Bus associations and add Inventory.Item on the object implementing Connector.Port?
We now have only 1 class.
No we don't have association between Port and PortMetrics dbus object paths. bmcweb appends Metric name to Port object path to get the PortMetric object path.
nit, followup is fine, This only ever needs to be encoded once.
I will fix this in a followup patch.
This needs rework to match updated PDIs (please review the PDIs).
Done.
Don't think this is still as per https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/+/84839. I don't see the port_ in the D-Bus object path.
Done.

We have to use pcie_devices suffix for the inventory since just using `/xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/Nvidia_ConnectX_0` would have PCIeDevice and NetworkAdapter interfaces at the same object path and that would cause PCIe ports to appear in NetworkAdapater Redfish collection URI along with Network ports and vice versa due to association between ports and inventory path.
